entities.name: Heliokles II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Heliocles II Dicaeus is thought to have been one of the later Indo-Greek kings and a relative of the Bactrian king Heliocles I. Current scholarly consensus is that he ruled ca 95–80 BC.
